page.overview:
Who is Foot Soldiers?

In most instances, Foot Soldiers are the most common enemy the face in any given video game. Often, they will come in many colors, each wielding a different weapon.

Following in the thousand year tradition of karate combat, he's a killing machine blindly guided by 's commands.

Although the illustration in the instruction manual is similar to its appearance in the 1987 TV series, the sprite does not reflect this, instead taking on the appearance of a bizarre, lanky ninja in dark blue/purplish clothing. They often attack with physical strikes and shuriken. Foot Soldiers are sometimes utilized as mini-bosses. On the boss they jump out of it dressed in red.

Minor soldier patrolling the streets. When an enemy is found, will relentlessly chase them.
